sentence: I need to ______ early tomorrow for school.
explanation: El phrasal verb <wake up> significa dejar de dormir.

sentence: Please ______ the TV. It's too loud.
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn off> significa apagar un aparato.

sentence: She ______ her coat because it was cold outside.
explanation: El phrasal verb <put on> significa ponerse ropa.

sentence: Can you ______ this word in the dictionary?
explanation: El phrasal verb <look up> significa buscar información.

sentence: He ______ smoking last year.
explanation: El phrasal verb <give up> significa dejar de hacer algo.

sentence: Don't ______ your shoes on the sofa.
explanation: El phrasal verb <take off> significa quitarse ropa o zapatos.

sentence: I ran ______ of milk, so I went to the shop.
explanation: El phrasal verb <run out of> significa quedarse sin algo.

sentence: It's raining cats and dogs means it's raining ______.
explanation: El modismo <raining cats and dogs> significa que está lloviendo muy fuerte.

sentence: Break a leg means ______.
explanation: El modismo <break a leg> se usa para desearle buena suerte a alguien.

sentence: A piece of cake means something is very ______.
explanation: El modismo <a piece of cake> significa que algo es muy fácil de hacer.

sentence: Hit the books means to ______ hard.
explanation: El modismo <hit the books> significa estudiar intensamente.

sentence: Under the weather means feeling ______.
explanation: El modismo <under the weather> significa sentirse enfermo o mal.

sentence: Let the cat out of the bag means to reveal a ______.
explanation: El modismo <let the cat out of the bag> significa revelar un secreto.

sentence: A person who teaches is a ______.
explanation: Añadir el sufijo <-er> a <teach> forma el sustantivo <teacher> (una persona que enseña).

sentence: A person who acts in films is an ______.
explanation: Añadir el sufijo <-or> a <act> forma el sustantivo <actor>.

sentence: The opposite of happy is ______.
explanation: Añadir el prefijo <un-> a <happy> crea el significado opuesto: <unhappy>.

sentence: Something that is full of beauty is ______.
explanation: Añadir el sufijo <-ful> a <beauty> forma el adjetivo <beautiful>.

sentence: A person who plays music is a ______.
explanation: Añadir el sufijo <-ian> a <music> forma el sustantivo <musician>.

sentence: Something without care is ______.
explanation: Añadir el sufijo <-less> a <care> significa sin cuidado: <careless>.

sentence: She ______ to school every day. (Change: 'She goes to school' → negative)
explanation: Para formar el negativo en presente simple con she/he: <doesn't> + verbo en forma base.
